newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Demand edges up on Bulgaria depo mkt, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Demand edges up on Bulgaria depo mkt, rates flat.

text.p: Demand for interbank lev deposits edged up on Bulgaria's money market on Tuesday but depo rates were unchanged from Monday, dealers said.
"Bids for funds for periods of up to seven days slightly rose as banks aim to regulate their short-term liquidity but supply still tops demand and rates are unchanged from yesterday," said a dealer.
Interbank overnight lev deposit rates stood at 1.50-1.75 percent annually, flat from Monday. Spot week lev rates were also unchanged at 2.5-3.0 percent annually.
The central bank has raised its main lev interest rate to 5.50 percent simple annual from 5.42 percent, effective Monday.
